 Follow Us On: News India Video Political debate emerges on corporate espionage and data leaks at Guidance Tamil Nadu Advertisement Political debate emerges on corporate espionage and data leaks at Guidance Tamil Nadu
 India Today Video Desk UPDATED: Nov 20, 2026 18:52 IST A political debate has arisen concerning alleged corporate espionage and sensitive data leaks at Guidance Tamil Nadu, with claims pointing towards investment sabotage linked to Andhra Pradesh. Political analyst Suman C Raman criticised the official response for lacking clarity on employee departures and data compromise. He called for a formal enquiry and transparent findings from the state Industries Department. Senior journalist Sandhya Ravishankar stated that evidence of organised interstate spying is unproven, emphasising that corporate investment decisions are influenced by senior business leaders rather than middle management.
